sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a dark gallery inside a tower of the makers split by a black chasm; inside the soft round circle of a lantern's light, glowing moss-stepping-stones appear across the chasm, and outside the circle there is nothing to see. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack, a little glowing lantern charm at their hip, stands on a stone midway across, dwarfed by the dark. On the far side, low in the west wall, a niche with a dark lamp, and a glass orb of pool water glowing soft gold rolls down a groove toward it before its glow fades. High over the way in behind, a carved eye seen only in the light. Friezes of three lamps over a hull. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, deep blue-violet darkness, warm lamp gold, moss green glow, coral glints, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
